verdicts.label: NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: While crocodiles have been sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru on several occasions over the years, there is no evidence to confirm a sighting of two crocodiles on October 3, 2026.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple news reports from 2010, 2023, 2024, and early 2026 confirm that crocodiles have been seen in Kukkarahalli Lake. However, none of the provided evidence supports the specific claim that two crocodiles were seen on the evening of October 3, 2026. Without a specific report for the claimed date and number of crocodiles, the claim cannot be verified.
